description: Paired wedge-edged boards clamped against each side of a textblock in the press during backing. Their bevelled edges sit a short way below the spine so the projecting sections can be hammered over them to form the shoulder.
name: backing boards

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter VIII, p.114. Internet Archive.
